VERIFICATION LOG — EVIDENCE
### 2026-10-01 — worker — activated

Selected the bounded register-handoff optimization after the prior clock
investigation rejected its candidates. Source inspection finds a 31-word scan
in `XRegs::jit_commit_words_mask`; compiled FP commits already use sparse bit
iteration. Work is isolated in the `emulator-speed-next` worktree; unrelated
edits in the user's original checkout are preserved.

### 2026-10-01 — worker — candidate selection (negative)

Six implementations were screened. Sparse iteration alone regressed full masks;
a full-copy special case regressed near-full masks; a threshold with an iterator
scan regressed mixed masks. Preserving the fixed-slice scan removed those large
regressions. The empty/full-only variant and the final inlining variant still
failed the repeated >1.02x sparse gate. The latter reached 1.0200539197x in its
screen, then only 1.0138260311x at frozen head `29980ba5`. No threshold was lowered.

Production `jit_commit_words_mask` is restored to parent `ec178d57`. Only tests,
the benchmark harness, measured evidence and demo documentation will remain.
No faster browser/Omarchy/boot behavior is claimed. Exact worker submission and
fresh-verifier verdict follow after restored-head gates and publication.
ADVERSARIAL VERIFICATION
A fresh verifier predicts register/stamp values before reading evidence; attack
x0-only, highest register, dense masks, wrap and precise fault prefixes. Compare
recorded guest state to the untouched implementation and inspect each changed
runtime hunk. Independently recount paired benchmark medians, invent one bounded
mask attack, and sabotage-check a new regression. Verify the frozen clone and
served artifact hashes. No runtime edits by the verifier; leave PRs open.
